mainEntity.name: Is a reconditioned engine better than a used one?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not always, but it usually offers more certainty. A reconditioned engine has been rebuilt and inspected, while a used engine is supplied as found. The right choice depends on your budget, vehicle value and plans.

mainEntity.name: Do you have reconditioned Range Rover engines for sale?

acceptedAnswer.text: We can help source reconditioned Range Rover engines for full-size, Sport, Evoque and Velar models. Availability depends on your exact engine code and specification, so send your registration and we will check suitable options for your vehicle.

mainEntity.name: How do I know which engine fits my vehicle?

acceptedAnswer.text: The correct replacement depends on your model, year, fuel type and engine code, not just the engine size. Share your registration or VIN, and we will help confirm which Range Rover engine matches your vehicle before you order.

mainEntity.name: Can you supply a second hand Range Rover engine for sale?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we can discuss a second hand Range Rover engine if it suits your budget. A used unit usually costs less, but its condition is less certain, so we explain the trade-offs compared with a reconditioned engine.

mainEntity.name: Is replacing the engine worth it on an older Range Rover?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the vehicle’s value, overall condition and how long you plan to keep it. A reconditioned Range Rover engine may be worthwhile in some cases, and we will tell you honestly if it may not be.

mainEntity.name: Do you fit engines for Evoque, Sport and Velar?

acceptedAnswer.text: We offer supply only or supply and fit for Range Rover Evoque, Sport and Velar models, as well as the full-size Range Rover. Contact us with your vehicle details to confirm the right engine and fitting arrangements.

mainEntity.name: What details should I send with my enquiry?

acceptedAnswer.text: Please send your registration number, model, year and a short description of the engine problem. Any recent diagnostic results, warning messages or garage reports also help us understand the issue and recommend suitable engine options.
